scenario.title: The Nguyens: family townhouse with a cat and a courtyard
scenario.room: Open-plan family living and kitchen area: L-shaped sofa, kids' toys on the rug, low shelves with plants, sliding door to a small courtyard

suggestions.name: Labrador Retriever
suggestions.reason: Great moderate family dog that thrives with older children and regular daily exercise.
suggestions.watch_out: Plan careful introductions and clear boundaries around your resident cat.

suggestions.name: Cavalier King Charles Spaniel
suggestions.reason: Gentle and affectionate companion that fits very well into a family home.
suggestions.watch_out: Monitor initial interactions with your cat until both pets feel secure.

suggestions.name: Coton de Tulear
suggestions.reason: Playful and sweet small dog that easily adapts to your household routine.
suggestions.watch_out: Introduce gradually to your cat to foster a peaceful relationship.

suggestions.name: Barbet
suggestions.reason: Friendly and eager to please medium breed that suits older children.
suggestions.watch_out: Supervise early meetings with your cat to ensure safety.

suggestions.name: French Bulldog
suggestions.reason: Calm and affectionate companion suited for a comfortable house with older kids.
suggestions.watch_out: Keep initial cat meetings controlled and brief at first.

suggestions.name: Bohemian Shepherd
suggestions.reason: Intelligent and trainable medium dog well suited to a family household.
suggestions.watch_out: Plan slow cat introductions to establish calm cohabitation.

suggestions.name: Clumber Spaniel
suggestions.reason: Easygoing large companion that fits seamlessly into your moderate daily activity.
suggestions.watch_out: Allow your cat time and safe space to adjust gradually.

suggestions.name: Bulldog
suggestions.reason: Quiet and gentle medium dog that matches your moderate activity routine.
suggestions.watch_out: Supervise interactions with your cat during the adjustment period.
